# You want to contribute?

Thanks for taking the time to help make **easypygamewidgets** better! We appreciate all contributions whether it's
reporting bugs, improving the documentation or submitting code fixes and new ideas.

---

Here are a few easy guidelines to help you:

## How Can I Contribute?

### 1. Reporting Bugs

Found a glitch?

- **Check existing issues:** Make sure the bug hasn't already been
  reported [here](https://github.com/PizzaPost/easypygamewidgets/issues).
- **Open a new issue:** Use a clear title, a minimal reproducible example, your Python/pygame-ce version and the
  behaviour you expected vs. what actually happens.
- **Wait:** Wait until we fix your bug :)

### 2. Suggesting Features & Improvements

Have an idea for a new widget or a better way to do something?

- **Check existing issues:** Make sure the idea hasn't already been
  reported [here](https://github.com/PizzaPost/easypygamewidgets/issues).
- **Open a new issue:** Open an issue describing your idea.
- **(Optional) Example:** Give an example code if you want so that we can see better how you image the feature to be
  implemented.

### 3. Submitting Code

I greatly appreciate that and of course will mention you.
You can just create a pull request with your code changes. I'll look through and then merge it.

It would be nice if you could stick to the same code style as the rest of the project :)
